description: This header defines the class em_orch_agent_t, which extends em_orch_t and provides orchestration agent functionalities for handling commands, pre-processing, validation, and transient operations within an execution management system.

classes.name: em_orch_agent_t
classes.description: A class that extends em_orch_t, providing orchestration capabilities such as building candidates, pre-processing commands, handling cancellations, and executing transient commands in an execution management environment.

methods.name: build_candidates
methods.description: Generates candidate elements based on the provided command, returning the count of candidates built.

methods.name: pre_process_orch_op
methods.description: Handles pre-processing steps for an orchestration operation, returning success status.

methods.name: pre_process_cancel
methods.description: Performs necessary steps to cancel a command within the em_t context.

methods.name: is_em_ready_for_orch_exec
methods.description: Checks if the execution manager (EM) is ready to execute an orchestration command.

methods.name: is_em_ready_for_orch_fini
methods.description: Determines if the EM is ready to finalize/complete the orchestration process.

methods.name: orch_transient
methods.description: Processes a transient orchestration command for a given EM instance.

methods.name: em_orch_agent_t
methods.description: Constructor that initializes an orchestration agent with a manager reference.
